sinopsis.es: Clara, adolescente de una pequeña comunidad indígena en los Andes, criada por su madre adoptiva partera, sueña con ser estrella de música folclórica en la ciudad.
sinopsis.en: Clara, a teenager in an Andean indigenous community, learns she was adopted from a sacred condor. As her eighteenth birthday approaches, she must choose between the human world she knows and the one she came from.
